snippet.title: Version 5.7 "A Space and Time for You" Trailer | Genshin Impact #NewVersion #Trailer #GenshinImpact
snippet.description:
Take a break from your journey to explore the world.
In that fleeting moment, someone's homeland was destroyed, and someone was reunited with their family.
No one can guarantee that this journey will go smoothly. All we can hope for is to reach a happy ending.

Traveler, you can enable subtitles while watching!
Chinese Voice-Over Video: https://youtu.be/HESnvskPgfw
Korean Voice-Over Video: https://youtu.be/SAo9OkIOR4Y

Due to recording arrangements, this video will be shown with Japanese audio. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
